annotations.title: Certificate fields as a JSON schema

description: Returns the fields an Electrical Installation Certificate (eic), Minor Electrical Installation Works Certificate (minor_works) or Electrical Installation Condition Report (eicr) needs, as a JSON Schema the assistant fills from the job notes and test readings (spark-pack-certs-1.0 (for BS 7671:2018+A4:2026 certificates)). Includes which certificate to use when, and the contractor block prefilled from `trade` if given. check_certificate checks the filled object. Field names are Spark Pack's own; the electrician transfers the values to the official form in their scheme portal or software.

certificate.description: eic for new circuits, consumer units and new installations; minor_works for additions or alterations to one existing circuit; eicr for periodic inspection reports.

trade.description: Optional. The electrician's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill certificate contractor fields and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Spark Pack.

address.description: Business address for the certificate contractor block.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Bright Sparks Electrical".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme the business is registered with.

name: get_certificate_schema
title: Certificate fields as a JSON schema
